thread:
nina: Tiny kitchen PSA: someone put a half-eaten matcha cake back in the box without a lid. Could the owner please claim it? We have a few mouse-phobic coworkers. :(
owen: Not mine. saw it on the counter this morning.
marta: That was probably mine, oops  I moved it to a plate and covered it now. sorry team.
gil: While we're on it, vote: rotate snack duty weekly or keep ad-hoc? :one: = weekly, :two: = ad-hoc.
snackbot: Poll started: rotate_weekly=0, ad_hoc=0. React with :one: or :two:.
nina: Weekly for me. less random, fewer bitter passive-aggressive post-its.
owen: :two: I actually like ad-hoc. Folks who want to run can.
marta: :one: from me. also can we get a small roll of cling wrap and a spare cake box? I will replace the guilty box.
kitchen-ops: We have cling_wrap=1 roll left. Adding spare cake_box to next supply order. Reminder: sticker label printer in supply closet for name+date.
snackbot: Inventory ping: cling_wrap=1, paper_plates=12, napkins=40, cake_box=0, oat_milk=2. Low: cake_box.
gil: Okay looks like weekly rotation wins by consensus in this thread. I'll grab a tiny signup sheet and post it on the fridge.
marta: Thanks gil. Also apology gift  I put extra cookies in the communal jar. Claim 'em.
own: Cookies stolen by midnight, report to snack detective. :sunglasses:
